the_c_r2_clause_restored: Construct each mutation, ELABORATE THE MUTATED TERM FIRST, discard any mutation whose term did not change, COUNT THE DISCARDS, and only then score the survivors.

That is the clause C-V4 inherited the idea from and left behind. A mutation that does not change the term is not a near miss the gate failed to catch — it is not a near miss at all, and scoring it as one is how a control talks itself into a bad number as readily as a good one.

reproducibility_settled_first.question: same inputs, same model, temperature 0 — byte-identical across two passes? No seed field exists anywhere in this tree, so it had never been tested.
reproducibility_settled_first.consequence: the instrument repeats, so it is allowed to confirm as well as void. Had it failed, C-V3′ would have published that and reverted to ABSENT.

served_arm_floor_reasoning: Chance is 0.25 with four candidates. A floor of 0.50 is twice chance: high enough that clearing it means the reader is doing something, low enough that it was not set where the pilot's arrow landed (0.7714 on 35 items).
The floor is on the SERVED arm only. C-V3′'s voiding is not governed by it — it is governed by the sentence inherited from C-V3, which compares the two arms.

inherited_voiding_sentence.text: if the skeleton arm is marked determinate at >= half the served arm's rate, the voice claim is void — the sheet is measuring the reader's mathematical guesswork, not the rendering
inherited_voiding_sentence.inherited_from: docs/DESIGN-foreign-voice.md §7 C-V3, unchanged, per the supersession block's reconciliation in favour of the seed

the_pilot_already_fires_it_and_that_is_r.what_it_means: the reader picks the true term from a SCRAMBLED sentence at 0.53 against 0.77 from the real one. It is substantially not reading the words.
the_mechanism_is_identifiable_and_is_the: The distractors are STRUCTURAL mutations — a deleted grouping pair, a shifted group, a swapped binder — so the four candidates differ in bracket shape and binder order.

C-V1's scramble DELIBERATELY LEAVES GROUPING WORDS UNTOUCHED. That is v0.18's measured lesson, not an oversight: a scramble that also broke parenthesisation would fail in the parser and prove nothing about whether the gate reads the words.

So a skeleton sentence still carries the true bracket structure and the true numerals — exactly enough to pick a structural distractor apart without reading one content word. Two instruments that are each correct alone interact badly when composed.
This is reported as the finding rather than repaired by redesigning the sheet after seeing the number. Tuning a control to flatter itself is the failure C-V4 taught this project to name.
the_pilot_already_fires_it_and_that_is_r.why_it_is_recorded_now: the pilot's numbers are in the tree before the full arm runs, so nobody can later mistake a redesign for a discovery

full_arm.sampling_rule: the same seeded rule as the pilot, over the covered set, with the sample size fixed here before it runs

c_v3_prime.it_does_not_stop_the_cycle: DESIGN-voice-completion §8: C-V3′ is an instrument this cycle is buying, not a gate the voice hangs on. A voided C-V3′ reading means the machine-reader claim is NOT MADE; the voice's fate rests on C-G1 and C-V4′.
what_is_not_claimed_either_way: No human-reader claim. C-V3 stays ABSENT.
No readability claim. A machine reader measures whether the sentence determines the term TO THAT MACHINE.
With the voiding sentence fired, not even the machine claim is made.

arm_result.the_pilot_predicted_it: the pilot's ratio was 0.6913 on 50 items; the arm's is 0.594 on 160. Both fire the inherited voiding sentence, and the pilot's was recorded before the arm ran.
reading: The reader is good at the served sentences — 0.8417, far above the 0.50 floor and the 0.25 chance rate. Taken alone that would look like a strong result.

It is also right half the time when the words are SCRAMBLED. So a large share of that 0.84 is not word-reading; it is recovering the term from what the scramble leaves intact — the bracket structure and the numerals — against distractors that differ precisely in bracket structure and binder order.
That is the failure C-V3's voiding sentence was written to catch, caught. The instrument worked; the claim does not survive it.
